001package com.streamconverter;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004
005/**
006 * Abstract parent type for external system failures (notification classes T and A in the exception
007 * policy).
008 *
009 * <p>This is an internal abstraction for the exception hierarchy. Callers must not directly throw
010 * this type; use one of its concrete subtypes instead:
011 *
012 * <ul>
013 *   <li>{@link ExternalTransientException} for temporary failures that may resolve with retry
014 *   <li>{@link ExternalPermanentException} for failures that require administrator intervention
015 * </ul>
016 *
017 * <p>Callers who need to handle both transient and permanent external failures can use this type as
018 * a catch target:
019 *
020 * <pre>{@code
021 * try {
022 *   converter.execute();
023 * } catch (ExternalSystemException e) {
024 *   // Handle both transient and permanent external failures
025 *   log.error("External system failure", e);
026 * }
027 * }</pre>
028 *
029 * <p>Extends {@link StreamProcessingException}, and therefore {@link IOException}, so that callers
030 * of {@link com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand#execute} can handle all stream-level
031 * failures with a single {@code catch (IOException)} block.
032 *
033 * <p>See docs/reference/EXCEPTION_POLICY.md for the full exception classification policy.
034 *
035 * @see ExternalTransientException
036 * @see ExternalPermanentException
037 */
038public abstract class ExternalSystemException extends StreamProcessingException {
039  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
040
041  /**
042   * Constructs a new ExternalSystemException with the specified detail message.
043   *
044   * @param message the detail message
045   */
046  protected ExternalSystemException(String message) {
047    super(message);
048  }
049
050  /**
051   * Constructs a new ExternalSystemException with the specified detail message and cause.
052   *
053   * @param message the detail message
054   * @param cause the underlying cause
055   */
056  protected ExternalSystemException(String message, Throwable cause) {
057    super(message, cause);
058  }
059
060  /**
061   * Constructs a new ExternalSystemException with the specified cause.
062   *
063   * @param cause the underlying cause
064   */
065  protected ExternalSystemException(Throwable cause) {
066    super(cause);
067  }
068}
